mutant: pub fn schema() -> &'static str { "CREATE TABLE tasks(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,title TEXT,done INTEGER DEFAULT 0)" }
pub fn report_sql() -> &'static str { "SELECT t.id,t.title,p.name FROM tasks t JOIN projects p ON p.id=t.project_id ORDER BY p.name,t.id" }
pub fn title_sql() -> &'static str { "SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE title LIKE ?1 ORDER BY id" }
